digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler binding lifecycle and idempotency harness
propositions: The binding_lifecycle absence cluster (clear_absent, note_absent, note_absent_or_rekey) lacks an integration-tier mutation oracle; its no-churn/change-gating contract is only pinned at unit tier because the idempotency fixture seeds all keys in-window, making clear_absent unreachable on healthy passes.

The bound-but-absent direct GET code path runs through a REAL backend whose HTTP transport 404s for synthetic keys instead of routing to the fake harness transport, blocking test coverage of the 404 -> alive round-trip.

An integration test must verify that an out-of-window-but-alive key reaches clear_absent with zero mutations, zero Jira writes, unchanged updated_at, and stable bindings.json bytes across repeated passes, such that unconditionally stamping updated_at in clear_absent drives the test RED.

The harness must be extended with out_of_window and deleted key sets on _FakeJiraState, monkeypatching reconcile_run_differs._load_reconcile_backend to wire the fake transport through the real JiraBackend adapter so the full reconcile chain is exercised.

A second integration test must pin the 404 -> alive round-trip by verifying note_absent records the absence with a frozen lifecycle clock sentinel and clear_absent's TRUE branch resets the absence counter, exercising the moved cluster's siblings at integration tier.
Pre-existing idempotency tests must remain unmodified in behavior and assertion, lint/typecheck/complexity gates must pass, and no src/rebar file changes are permitted.
